breakdown.description: The global horizontal traction on the left slope is reinterpreted as slope-aligned tangential shear
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly re-defined the horizontal traction as a slope-aligned tangential shear. The generated specification creates a contradictory statement by including both instructions: 'Apply a tangential shear traction of 6000 Pa on the left slope. The traction is applied horizontally, aligned with the global x-direction.' A tangential traction on a sloped surface is not horizontal. By including the incorrect term 'tangential shear traction', the agent failed to fix the error as specified by the ground truth, which simply requires a 'horizontal traction'.
